src: scripts/histcities/ — 11 handwritten region files plus 3 derived from upstreams; built by scripts/build-hist-cities.mjs
note: Outside every span the modern tile label stands. `g` is the guard radius in metres: a tile label is renamed only if its own spelling is one of `k` AND it lies within `g` of (lon, lat). `f`/`t` are signed YYYYMMDD (negative years are astronomical, so -330 is 331 BC). `p` is the precision of those two endpoints — d day, m month, y year, c a period boundary from a vocabulary rather than a date, - open. `a` is a bitmask over `langs`: a set bit means a source writes this name in that language. A language with a clear bit has no column of its own and falls back to `en`, which is the record’s own spelling — and for 537 of the 9246 spans that spelling is not in Latin script, because no source wrote the name in any of `langs`. `s` is the source: h the handwritten record, o ohm, p pleiades, w wikidata.
